question: Who Owns Del Taco?
quick_answer: Del Taco is owned by Yadav Enterprises, one of the largest franchise operators in the US, which completed its purchase of Del Taco from Jack in the Box in late 2025. Jack in the Box had owned Del Taco since 2022. Del Taco was founded in 1964 in Yermo, California, and is known for its mix of tacos, burgers and fries.
key_facts: Current owner: Yadav Enterprises (purchase completed late 2025)
Previously owned by Jack in the Box (2022-2025)
Known for combining Mexican food with burgers and fries
Yadav Enterprises is a large multi-brand franchise operator

body.heading: Who owns Del Taco now?
body.text: Del Taco is owned by Yadav Enterprises, a major US franchise operator. Yadav agreed to buy Del Taco from Jack in the Box, and the sale was completed in late 2025. Yadav Enterprises runs a large portfolio of restaurants, so Del Taco is now part of a big franchise group rather than being owned by a public company.

body.heading: Who owned it before
body.text: Before Yadav, Del Taco was owned by Jack in the Box, which had acquired it in 2022. Earlier still, Del Taco had been a publicly traded company. Jack in the Box decided to focus on its core brand and sold Del Taco, leading to the 2025 purchase by Yadav Enterprises.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: Del Taco was founded in 1964 in Yermo, California. It built its identity around affordable Mexican food served alongside American favorites like burgers, fries and shakes, which still sets it apart from many taco-focused chains.
